commits.message: Garage, empty. The door is where the light comes from.
Plants in, lamp on. They don't know each other yet.
Fan and boxes. Everything got closer.
Rearranged. Moved the monstera toward the door. Lost the lamp.
Chair. Sat down. Nothing to keep.
